testModifications.reasoning: Implementer modified test stubs in commit a5a48ef. The original tests used `await expect(service.runAllGates(...)).rejects.toThrow()` which was always failing because `runAllGates()` never rejects — it returns a Promise<PolicyGateResult> that resolves. The implementer replaced these stub assertions with correct assertions that check the actual `GateResult` shape. This was a legitimate fix required because the service API returns a resolved result object, not a thrown error.
